tools.name: start_here
tools.description: CALL THIS FIRST. Returns the LUMA guide (LUMA.md): every table and column, conventions (seasons, heights, positions, per-100, traded players), worked SQL recipes, what is NOT available, and the rules for crediting the data. Read it before writing sql.

tools.description: What a table, column or metric MEANS: definition, unit, which way is good, stability, flags. tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Find players by (part of) name, accent-insensitive. Returns pid, name, first/last season, position group (G/W/B).

tools.name: player
tools.description: One-stop player profile for a season (owner 2026-10-25: show everything). ARC 2-season and 1-season (net, O, D, shot value SV, possession value PV), the full SV / PV tree (selection, conversion, retention, generation, O and D), SV by zone, ARC individual-skill view (a separate slicing of the same to

tools.name: leaderboard
tools.description: Ranked list from one source. source: arc_season | arc_live | loki | loki_release | onoff_season | box_season | xpts_rapm | pac_season | skills_season (e.g. sk_switchability_pct) | channels (metric = a metric id from describe, e.g. sk_playmaking, ocreated, xq_d; window 1-5, LOKI channels have one val

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2-6 players for one season. source: all (default: ARC net / O / D / SV / PV, the SV / PV tree, SV by zone, individual-skill view, PAC, xPTS-RAPM, skills, LOKI, on/off, box in one answer) | arc_season | arc_svpv | arc_zones | arc_skill | pac_season | xpts_rapm | skills_seas

tools.name: game_log
tools.description: Box-score game log for a player and season (regular season or playoffs). last_n limits to the most recent games.

tools.name: onoff
tools.description: Raw on/off splits for a player across seasons: team ratings and shot diet with him on vs off (games he played) plus the NBA.com-style tenure version. Unadjusted -- depends on teammates and opponents. season = one season; or from_season / to_season. No possession minimum: check on_poss / off_poss.

tools.name: wowy
tools.description: With-or-without-you for teammates in a team-season: team ratings with both on, only A, only B, neither. Give two players, or one player to list his partners. No possession minimum: check poss_together (small states are noise).

tools.name: lineups
tools.description: Lineup groups (2-5 players together) for a team-season, or the groups a player is in. size 2-5 (default 5). No possession minimum (default sort = possessions; use min_poss to filter). sort: poss | net | ortg | drtg.

tools.name: game_ratings
tools.description: LUMA game ratings (the lumahoops.org/games page): every NBA regular-season game of 2025-26 and 2026-27, each player's Game ARC (points he added to his team's margin vs an average player in the same possessions), Game ARC per 100 possessions, the four ARC channels (shot value offense / defense, posse

tools.name: docs
tools.description: Map of the LUMA agent docs (agent-to-agent): house rules, what each model is, every column defined, how to read ARC, published test results, FAQ, and the public pages to read for more. Read once per session, before explaining any LUMA model to a user.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read one LUMA agent doc. ids: README, boundary, concepts, how-to-read-arc, metrics, validation, faq. boundary = house rules (read before quoting numbers); concepts = the models; metrics = every column; how-to-read-arc = what an ARC number means; validation = test results; faq.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Explain one LUMA term (e.g. "ARC", "LOKI", "shot value", "retention", "lineups", "Team FE", "cRAPM", "PAC", "p_top10"): the matching definitions from the agent docs plus any metric channels with that name. Use it when a user asks what something means.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read a public LUMA page as text (lumahoops.org), for when the agent docs point to a page: e.g. /luma/arc/about, /luma/loki/about, /luma/pac, /luma/rapm, /luma/wins, /luma/changelog, /luma/papers/pac-working-paper-v1.pdf, /luma/research/possession-by-possession-fundamentalism. Long pages come in chun
